scope: Four selected checks across MLP04/MLP05; no total answer grades or winner. All other material claims remain unchecked.

post_collection_operator_research.explanation: Source-review work after all ten native answers completed; no extra reader/provider endpoint script.

checks.claim_paraphrase: Corrected speculative sampling preserves the target distribution subject to numerical precision.
checks.assessment: Supported as a statement about the algorithms described by these papers.
checks.scope_and_limitations: The two abstracts explicitly describe distribution preservation; the pinned vLLM page qualifies numerical/batching behavior and logprob stability. This does not validate a local sampler or every speedup/table claim in the answer.

checks.claim_paraphrase: The quality gate is met on the supplied 100 cases; latency and all-in cost remain unknown; adoption is deferred.
checks.assessment: Consistent with supplied hypothetical inputs and original gates.
checks.scope_and_limitations: 96/100 to 97/100 is +1 percentage point; the raw reported latency reduction is 24%, but 80-vs-100 coverage/unknown conditions prevent a matched pass; active-only 0.014 leaves 0.006 of the 0.020 all-in ceiling, with overhead unknown. This is arithmetic and limited interpretation, not validation of any real result.
